_about: ROUTEBOT v1 (laneROUTEBOT): -routebot:<dir> (with -zones). A scripted player walks the zone route in a real build and writes <dir>\routebot.json (per step PASS / FAIL with checks and evidence) plus upright PNG frames in <dir>\frames. Read by Scripts/Zones/ZoneRouteBot.cs (StreamingAssets first, then Assets\Data). Without the flag nothing here is read. Every number below is a tunable; none is in code. Spots are zones.json spots (zone + spot id), spawns are zones.json spawn ids, names come from opponents.json. UNPROVEN IN UNITY.

input._about: Keys are sent to the game window with the Windows SendInput API (the same path a keyboard uses: the legacy Input class, InputMap, PlayerBrain and MarketUI all read them). Only while the window is focused (Application.isFocused), all keys are released when focus is lost. Key names = UnityEngine.KeyCode; an action that InputMap knows (moveForward ... strike, guard, run) uses the player's own binding first, these are the fallbacks. tapFrames = frames a tapped key stays down (at least 2); tapMaxS caps it in seconds so a slow frame never turns a light into a heavy (heavyHoldMs 220). selfTest: before step 1 the bot holds selfTestKey and the game's own Input.GetKey must see it within selfTestFrames, else the run stops with the reason (window not focused, or keys not delivered).

capture._about: mode 'screen' = ScreenCapture.CaptureScreenshotAsTexture at the end of the frame (what the player sees, HUD included); 'camera' = Camera.main rendered into a RenderTexture (no HUD, as ZoneShot). flipY turns the PNG over if a build proves it upside down (every frame also logs the mean luma of its top and bottom tenth: lumaTop / lumaBottom). settleFrames = frames waited before the grab.

combat._about: The bot fights with real keys: it walks toward the foe (camera-relative, the way PlayerBrain turns keys into a direction), stops at approachGapM, taps strike every strikeIntervalS while the gap (body to body) is below attackGapM and stamina is above staminaMinFrac. guard: holds the guard key while the foe winds up inside guardGapM (centre guard only, no side, so it is off by default). assistHpFloorFrac: the player's health is put back to this fraction when it drops below it (counted, listed in the report as assists) so one bad exchange does not end the proof; 0 = no assist, the bot can die and the step fails.

stepDefaults._about: A step row lists only what differs: 0 / absent = the value here. timeoutS = the step budget (a step that runs past it FAILS and the run moves on); minBarDropFrac = how far the boss bar must fall; settleS = seconds the death is watched after the kill; finisherWaitS = extra wait for a finisher to release the camera; camMinFollowFrac = camera z must move this fraction of the player's z move; dwellS = seconds standing after a door; pushUntilGapM = stop pushing toward the second enemy at this gap; followWaitS = how long the chaser is watched; throughMarginM = metres beyond the door boundary that count as through; tapSettleFrames / maxDownPresses / closeTries = trader key pacing.

steps.name: Fresh start: Pitborn and Sobek alive, wake at pit_yard
Kill Pitborn with real inputs: health bar falls, death completes with no exception
Walk door 1 into sobek_reach: camera follows
Second pass: back to pit_yard with Pitborn alive
Walk past a live Pitborn: he chases through the door, then fights with Sobek (maxEngaged 2) or gives up at the data distance
Kill Sobek: HUD name reads Sobek, his health falls
Walk door 2 into hub_camp: camera follows, Joan stands on the ground
Trader: open, buy, sell, close; coins change
